channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis launch ballistic missile attacks on al-Makha and Marib
item.description: The latest attacks come just a day after Houthi rebels targeted al-Makha and its port, killing seven people.

item.title: Fire rages after drone strikes Libya’s largest oil refinery
item.description: A drone attack ignited gasoline at Libya's Zawiya oil refinery, the country's largest operational facility.

item.title: Where did all the money go if the US is running out of weapons?
item.description: The war on Iran is exposing shortages in US weapons stockpiles, raising questions about years of defence spending.

item.title: Trump demands compensation from Iran as talks on Strait of Hormuz continue
item.description: US president seeks payment for '50 years' of alleged damages after Iran conditions opening of Hormuz on war reparations.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump claims Hormuz Strait open, seeks Iranian compensation
item.description: US President Donald Trump said he will seek compensation from Iran for casualties in the war.

item.title: Inside a secret launch site for Ukraine’s deep-strike drones
item.description: AJ's Audrey MacAlpine reports from a secret launch site in eastern Ukraine, where soldiers prepare long-range drones.

item.title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
item.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
item.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

item.title: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
item.description: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

item.title: 30 years later, a former gang member will stand trial for Tupac's murder
item.description: It’s been three decades since Tupac was killed, and since then, his reputation has only grown.
